name: sx/hero
title: SX Hero
description: Above-the-fold hero: headline, one primary CTA, trust row and an optional offer/feature card.

guardrails: Exactly one primary CTA. The secondary action is a text link or ghost button.
Primary CTA must sit above the fold at 375x667.
Headline 60 characters max; subtitle 160 max (long Russian/Portuguese strings included).
scoreboard: the match card is an illustration and must carry a note saying odds are examples.
stat-led: the number must be a real brand fact (e.g. payout minutes) and match the trust bar.
full-bleed: art is CSS only for now; text sits on a scrim so contrast holds on any preset.
